title: Phase 61 publishes eight named conversion files and reconciles the Toronto Council gate
summary: Five local project files and three technology-adoption cases now name the current evidence stage, exact downstream artifact, date or reopening trigger, stop rule, and reader surfaces. Toronto application 24 254930 is reconciled to City Council adoption while enactment and delivery gates remain open.
evidence_note: Phase 61 synthesizes the existing reviewed corpus and adds no source, signal, promotion, score, readiness claim, or operating-outcome claim. Registry dates are editorial checks; reopening triggers are not forecasts that evidence will appear.
prior_state: Phase 59 organized broad local and adoption dossiers, while the Toronto gap register still carried a past-due pre-Council watch state.
current_state: Eight named conversion files and one flagship bind existing records to exact downstream artifacts; the Toronto gaps now reflect Council adoption and retain enactment, permit, start, completion, and occupancy boundaries.
publication_effect: Publishes nine briefings, one static registry export, one update, two reconciled gap decisions, five local-system links, and ten deepened reader pathways.
